about_the_game:
Beta Kafe is a cinematic visual novel where you’ll write your own love story.
Inspired by over 1,000 real dates, navigate the chaos of modern romance through your choices — and face the real consequences. Think you’ve got game? Prove it.

Everyone lies. Sometimes you’ll need to see through them — and sometimes, you’ll have to lie yourself. Every decision pulls you deeper into a web of romance, comedy, and confusion — not just with one, but four different dates, each cleverly intertwined.

Explore 150+ branching paths and unlock 35 unique endings in this one-of-a-kind dating story. Are you a smooth flirt, a hopeless romantic, or just trying to survive the night? Can you truly connect with someone — or are you just a side character in their story?

There’s only one way to find out.
Beta Kafe: Write Your Love Story.

💔 120+ Paths, 30+ Unique Endings, 10+ Finals – Interwoven stories shaped by unexpected, non-linear decisions.
🎥 Cinematic Visuals – A seamless experience. No black screens, no pauses. Your choices drive the story.
🎭 Test Your Dating Skills - Unlock nicknames, earn achievements, and see how you rank.
🕹️ Choose Your Difficulty – Hard like life, Medium, or Easy… like your ex.

See how much chaos you’ve stirred up so far?
Check out the CHAPTERS.

Parts you’ve played turn from dull grey into a fabulous rainbow of bad decisions. The paths you haven’t dared to touch—or simply couldn’t reach—stay unlit.

On Easy or Medium you can go back and explore them. On Hard, you’ve got no choice but to keep moving forward. Remember: if you picked Hard, it means you trust your dating game.

You’ll also spot your achievements and endings as you unlock them. And yes, it’s all connected—so much so that you can even edit your own movie to cover up for your terrible dating skills.

⚡ REACTIONS
Social interactions aren’t just about making choices — they’re about making moves. You’ll need to stay sharp and respond quickly if you want to steer the character toward what’s on their mind.

Not every moment calls for action. Some situations are better left alone. But when something feels right? You’ve got to act fast. A well-timed reaction can open doors… or close them forever.

This isn’t passive watching — it’s active ''storyshaping''. SHAPE YOURS.
🎯 CHOICES

We’re damn proud of this: there are so many choices, you’ll never be forced to make your character do something you wouldn’t.

Every option is grounded — realistic, situational, and true to the world. We built a bridge between you and your character. Before each decision, you’ll see a gold text prompt that lets you feel what your choice really means.

Sometimes, it’s your character speaking directly to you — so you know when you're lying, telling the truth, or making a bold move that could change everything.

WISHLIST NOW!
“Beta Kafe: because therapy is expensive. Get your taste of real-world dating—don't bomb every date like this loser.”

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains romance, suggestive themes, and occasional alcohol use (bar scenes). There is no explicit sexual content or nudity; any intimacy is non-graphic and typically fades to black. No graphic violence or self-harm. All characters are adults.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 Catalina or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M/U
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Graphics or equivalent
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Uses H.264 MP4 FMV content. 1080p playback runs well on Apple Silicon (M1+) and recent Intel Macs. For smooth 4K video, an SSD is recommended.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or newer
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1/M2 GPU
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Uses H.264 MP4 FMV content. 1080p playback runs well on Apple Silicon (M1+) and recent Intel Macs. For smooth 4K video, an SSD is recommended.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200 or equivalent
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 or equivalent
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Uses hardware-decoded H.264 MP4 video. 1080p playback runs well on integrated graphics (Intel UHD 620 or equivalent). For smooth 4K video, we recommend a dedicated GPU (GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better) and an SSD.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or higher
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Uses hardware-decoded H.264 MP4 video. 1080p playback runs well on integrated graphics (Intel UHD 620 or equivalent). For smooth 4K video, we recommend a dedicated GPU (GTX 1050 / RX 560 or better) and an SSD.

short_description: Think of the hero from your favorite romantic comedy. Now imagine he’s even dumber, hornier, and completely under your control. Beta Kafe is a raw dating simulator where every choice shapes his story. Funny, messy, and sometimes brutal — with 40+ unique endings waiting for you to write.
